description.value: A branch of the Royal Canadian Legion, a national veterans' service organization that has been active since 1926. Legion branches typically operate a licensed bar and canteen open to members and often to the public, making them a familiar stop for food and drink in many BC communities. This Victoria branch sits on Admirals Road in the Esquimalt area.
